_doc: Wizard D — Foresight (docs/design/wizard-d-foresight.md). Every number the forecast uses lives here; wizards/wizard_d_settings.py raises on a missing key and never invents a default. Probabilities are per account over horizon_days. `verticals` blocks override the same-named keys for one vertical — every block is empty today because no vertical has a measured base rate; a measured one goes there, never in code.

calibration._doc: basis flips from 'prior' to 'calibrated' only when the tenant has at least min_labels labelled decisions with at least min_per_class of each class. A label is a group of terminal outcomes (taxonomy buckets lost / protected / expansion) on one account within label_window_days of each other: any 'lost' → 0, else 1. Its stratum is the health band and leading label of the journey series month before the decision (point-in-time). prior_strength is the pseudo-count the account's own prior carries into the Beta update; a stratum below min_per_stratum labels uses the pooled counts and says so.

prior._doc: p_retain = clamp(base_retention_at_decision × health_band × leading_label × arc × phase × intervention). When no decision point (renewal / refresh / contract end) falls inside the horizon, the question is mid-term contraction: p_retain = 1 − midterm_loss_hazard ÷ (the same factor product) — factors below 1 raise the hazard, above 1 lower it. Factor values are template judgements (every one ≤ ~1.1 and ≥ ~0.5) — a prior, labelled as such on every block.

expansion._doc: p_expand over the horizon. expansion_intent_role_factor applies when an expansion_intent or expansion_realized role signal sits in the 90-day feature window. size_share_of_arr is the expected uplift given an expansion — one share, not a distribution (design §6).

loss._doc: Expected share of ARR lost when the account is not retained. The story-arc template's arr_at_risk_peak / arr_start is used when the account has an arc with a template (basis 'story_arc_template'); otherwise default_severity (basis 'config_default').

interval._doc: Prior-basis interval on p_retain and p_expand: ± half_width_p, widened by thin_evidence_extra when the account has fewer than thin_evidence_below_episodes episodes and by no_kpi_layer_extra when there is no KPI layer. Semantics 'template_range' — a declared range, not a sampling interval. Calibrated-basis intervals are Beta credible intervals at interval_level.

portfolio._doc: Per-account half-widths become σ at interval_level. 'independent' propagates sqrt(Σσ²) (headline); 'correlated' sums the bounds (worst case). Both are always reported; headline_assumption picks which one the tile shows first.
